jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Analyst provides analytical and cost controlling support to the EU FP&A team and Insulation business teams. The FP&A Analyst gathers, analyzes, prepares and summarizes data for forecasting and management reporting by extracting, validating and organizing financial data to prepare accurate and informative presentations and reports.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Live the Safety standard, adhere to the safety responsibilities.

- Adhere to Owens Corning safety policies and personal safety action plan at all times

What does success look like?

- Supporting accurate and timely financial reporting (monthly results, forecasting, budgeting, performance tracking)

- Support the team with cost planning and reporting preparation in SAP Analytics Cloud

- Assist in process improvements for forecasting, planning and financial modeling tools and processes

Skills and abilities needed:

- Being detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy and accountability for results

- Strong analytical skills, ability to gather insights from data and clearly communicate it to others

- Demonstrated collaboration and interpersonal skills; motivation to build relationships across functions

- Curiosity and a willingness to understand business processes

- Demonstrated high ethical standards and professional integrity

Business requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or Business Administration

- Experience in financial reporting or related field

- English language level B2

- Knowledge of SAP, SAC, PowerBI, AI-enabled tools considered an advantage

WE OFFER

- Opportunity to grow in an international team environment

- Be part of a purpose-driven organization focused on sustainability and innovation

- Access to a global e-learning platform

- A cozy, modern office located in the heart of Vilnius

- Private health insurance

- Shared company success through annual performance-based bonus

- A chance to contribute to meaningful organizational growth and transformationBachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or Business Administration

The gross monthly salary for this role is between 2900 to 3500 EUR gross, with the final offer reflecting your qualifications and experience.

jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
Descripción de la posición:

Es responsable de brindar soporte financiero estratégico a las áreas comerciales y de liderazgo, desarrollando análisis, proyecciones y recomendaciones que impulsen el crecimiento rentable del negocio. Colabora de manera cercana con gerentes y directores para influir en la toma de decisiones, garantizar el cumplimiento de objetivos financieros e identificar oportunidades de mejora en ventas, márgenes, gastos y rentabilidad.

Principales responsabilidades:

- Responsable de procesos de presupuesto, forecast y planeación financiera de corto y largo plazo.

- Ser el enlace financiero clave para las áreas comerciales y operativas del negocio.

- Analizar resultados financieros y comerciales para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y rentabilidad.

- Elaborar modelos financieros y análisis de escenarios para apoyar decisiones estratégicas.

- Presentar indicadores, dashboards y análisis ejecutivos a líderes de la organización.

- Impulsar iniciativas de optimización de costos, productividad y mejora de márgenes.

- Administrar y monitorear presupuestos y gastos operativos del negocio.

- Influir en la toma de decisiones mediante recomendaciones financieras y una comunicación efectiva con líderes y gerentes.

Perfil:

- Lic. En Finanzas, Economía, Administración de empresas. Con Título y Cédula profesional.

- Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en posiciones similares.

Conocimientos/experiencia requerida e indispensable:

- Experiencia en planeación y análisis financiero, finanzas estratégicas o evaluación de oportunidades de fusiones y adquisiciones, participando en la generación de análisis financieros y apoyo a la toma de decisiones del negocio.

- Excel avanzado.

- Inglés avanzado.

Deseable:

- Sólidas habilidades de presentación y comunicación con niveles gerenciales y directivos.

- Facilidad para hablar en público e influir en la toma de decisiones.

- Perfil dinámico, proactivo y orientado a la colaboración.

- Manejo de SAP.

Habilidades:

- Organización

- Negociación.

- Comunicación efectiva.

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Lead
jobs.description:
Drive Operational Excellence Through Total Productive Maintenance

Owens Corning is seeking a results-oriented TPM Lead to lead the evolution of Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) at our Brentwood, NH facility. This role is responsible for transforming TPM from a collection of activities into a sustainable, results-driven operating system that delivers measurable improvements in safety, quality, reliability, productivity, cost, and employee engagement.

As the site's TPM leader, coach, and change agent, you will partner with plant leadership, supervisors, pillar teams, and frontline employees to build TPM capability, accountability, and ownership across the organization. Success in this role will be measured by the performance improvements generated through TPM and the development of highly engaged teams that continuously improve equipment reliability and operational performance.

What You'll Do

TPM Leadership & Team Development

- Build, coach, and develop high-performing Autonomous Maintenance (AM) teams that own equipment health and loss elimination.

- Serve as the primary TPM coach and mentor for operators, supervisors, managers, and pillar leaders.

- Advance TPM maturity across the site by providing leadership, guidance, and support to AM and TPM Pillar Teams.

- Develop TPM capability through training, coaching, hands-on support, and continuous learning initiatives.

- Foster a culture where operators and frontline teams proactively solve problems, improve processes, and take ownership of their equipment.

Operational Excellence

- Align TPM activities with business objectives to drive measurable improvements in OEE, reliability, productivity, quality, and cost.

- Identify gaps between TPM implementation and operational performance and develop strategies to close them.

- Challenge non-value-added TPM activities and redirect efforts toward initiatives that generate measurable business results.

- Facilitate loss elimination activities and drive continuous improvement efforts across the plant.

- Monitor and evaluate TPM effectiveness to ensure sustained operational improvements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Autonomous Maintenance (AM), Planned Maintenance (PM), Focused Improvement (FI), Training & Development (T&D), EHS, and site leadership teams to address chronic losses and improve performance.

- Support TPM audits, assessments, and maturity reviews while ensuring readiness is built through sustainable daily behaviors rather than event-driven preparation.

- Drive accountability for TPM execution while maintaining ownership within operational teams.

- Maintain a strong presence on the plant floor, spending the majority of time coaching teams, observing behaviors, and developing capability.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

- Associate degree and 4+ years of TPM, Lean Manufacturing, or Continuous Improvement experience .

- Demonstrated understanding of TPM systems beyond administrative support.

- Experience deploying and accelerating TPM programs and pillars in a manufacturing environment.

- Experience serving as a Pillar Leader in one or more TPM pillars, including:

- Autonomous Maintenance (AM)

- Planned Maintenance (PM)

- Focused Improvement (FI)

- Training & Development (T&D)

- Experience leading an Autonomous Maintenance team through at least AM Step 4.

- Experience training and developing TPM expansion leaders.

- Proven ability to influence outcomes and drive change without direct authority.

- Ability to support a 24/7 manufacturing operation, including occasional schedule flexibility and travel to other Owens Corning facilities.

Preferred Qualifications

- TPM (JIPM) Certification.

- Prior experience leading site-wide TPM initiatives or manufacturing transformation efforts.

- Experience coaching teams and leaders through organizational and cultural change.

Skills & Competencies

- Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities.

- Ability to influence and lead through collaboration.

- Sound business acumen and operational decision-making skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication.

- Growth mindset, learning agility, and adaptability.

- Ability to build credibility and engagement at all levels of the organization.

- Passion for continuous improvement and employee development.

Why This Role Matters

This is not a traditional TPM coordinator role. The TPM Lead will serve as a catalyst for cultural and operational transformation, helping create an environment where teams own their equipment, eliminate losses, solve problems proactively, and deliver sustained business results. The successful candidate will build the systems, behaviors, and capabilities necessary to achieve world-class manufacturing performance.

About Owens Corning

Owens Corning is a branded building products leader with three complementary market-leading businesses providing roofing, insulation, and doors primarily for residential markets in North America and Europe. The company operates with an integrated go-to-market strategy and a unique set of OC Advantages™ – including its iconic brand, unparalleled commercial strength, leading technology, and winning cost position – to help customers win and grow in the market. Owens Corning is committed to helping build better and achieve more through winning partnerships, leading performance, and engaging people. Founded in 1938 and headquartered in Toledo, Ohio, Owens Corning is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: OC). For more information, visit  www.owenscorning.com .

Owens Corning is an equal opportunity employer. Except in limited circumstances such as formal apprenticeship programs, Owens Corning does not employ anyone under the age of 18.
